blog_title: DTF Print on Polyester vs Cotton — Why ₹30K Order Bubbled in Rain (Monsoon Printing Guide)
caption:
A ₹30K DTF order bubbled after one rain. Printer used polyester blend blanks—moisture got trapped under the print, customer washed once, everything peeled off. 😬

Turns out polyester traps moisture. Cotton absorbs it, keeps prints intact. We learned: 100% cotton, minimum 200 GSM for monsoon DTF.

A ₹500 sample test saves your ₹30K order.

Save this if you're sourcing blanks for your next bulk run 👇
